source.title: Hydraflow Rainfall Report, file SedgwickCoKS.IDF, project 07698_Detention.gpw, dated Thursday, Sep 4, 2008

assumptions: Intensity tolerance = 0.005 (printed to 0.01) + the largest change that rounding B, D and E to the printed 4 decimals can cause at these durations; Hydraflow evaluates unrounded coefficients (values computed from the printed ones fall on both sides of the printed table, so it is not truncation).
notes: Printed 10-yr FHA coefficients evaluated at the report's 5-60 min durations reproduce its printed intensity row.
